decisions.reason: Optical spectrum connectivity uses the firm's sunk fibre investment, was showcased on its own page, and is central to the announced high-bandwidth, software-defined direction, so management stays committed to it.
The number ordering portal is a low-cost software tool that supports real-time provisioning and the voice business, so dropping it gains little and keeping it is easy to justify.

Carrier pre-selection is shrinking legacy telephony with little strategic weight, but its low running cost, its regulatory ties and the firm's earlier choice to keep it lead management to read weak results as market-driven and keep it for another year.
Direct voice network connection builds on owned voice infrastructure and serves enterprise and service-provider customers, so the firm keeps investing in it despite the decline in industry turnover.
